label: Прочитав
description: A 10-sentence card for прочитав, the perfective gerund of прочитать.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: prior action, front position. Прочитав is the perfective gerund of прочитать, formed from the perfective stem plus -в. It names an action finished before the main verb: she finished reading, then cried. The gerund clause leads, set off by a comma.

missions.phrase: Прочитав книгу, я вернул её в библиотеку.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: completed then next step. Прочитав marks the prior completed reading (perfective stem + -в); only afterward came the return. The same subject does both: I read, I returned it.

missions.phrase: Прочитав статью, мы обсудим её завтра.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: future main clause. The main verb is future (обсудим), yet прочитав still fixes the earlier completed action. A perfective gerund orders events, not tenses: read first, discuss later, one shared subject.
Strategic focus: same-subject rule. Both actions belong to one subject: HE read the manual, HE switched on the device. Прочитав is indeclinable, so the link to он rests on meaning, not on any ending.

Strategic focus: plural subject, no agreement. The subject is plural (ученики), but прочитав takes no plural ending — gerunds never agree, unlike participles. Sequence: the problem read, then solving began.

Strategic focus: gerund in end position. The gerund clause comes after the main verb here, but the order of events holds: she read the lines first, then fell into thought. Прочитав stays one fixed form in any position.

missions.phrase: Прочитав отзывы, я понимаю твой выбор.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: present main clause. The main verb is present (понимаю), but прочитав reports a finished prior action: the reviews are read, and now I understand. A perfective gerund means completion whatever the main tense.
Strategic focus: tight sequence. Прочитав (прочитать, perfective + -в) marks the message read just before the reply. The two actions form a clear before-then-after chain under one subject.

Strategic focus: prior condition for action. The contract was read in full before the signing, and прочитав makes that order explicit. Past main verb with a perfective gerund, same subject throughout.

Strategic focus: everyday sequence. Прочитав names the completed prior act: the recipe was read, then the ingredients came out. The perfective gerund keeps the actions in order, both done by grandmother.
